name: Los Cabos
about: Gray whales migrate through and calve in nearby lagoons Dec–Apr.
overview: Desert meets ocean at the tip of the Baja Peninsula, built around golf, sportfishing, and beach resorts.
costOverview: The resort zone runs at real luxury-resort prices — step outside it toward San José's old town, and tacos and coffee are cheap.

costItems.label: Private marlin sportfishing charter, full day

specialSeasons.text: Gray whales migrate through and calve in the nearby lagoons — one of the most reliable whale-watching windows anywhere.
Hurricane season on the Pacific side — real risk of tropical storms, though direct hits are less frequent than the Caribbean coast.
